description:
Update tracking information for a shipment by ID and status. 

This tool updates tracking information such as the carrier or the tracking number for a specific shipment using the transaction ID and status.

new_tracking_number.description: The new tracking number for the shipment if being updated.

status.description: The status of the item shipment. It can be "CANCELLED", "DELIVERED", "LOCAL_PICKUP", "ON_HOLD", or "SHIPPED".

tracking_number.description: The tracking number that you want to update.

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID associated with the shipment tracking to retrieve.

name: update_shipment_tracking
